item.title: Juneau Assembly asks View Drive residents to help pay for their own buyout after years of outburst flooding
item.description: The city sent an informal ballot and letter to homeowners Wednesday to see if they’ll give up hundreds of thousands from their home payout to leave the cul-de-sac.

item.title: Homer Rep. Vance faces ethics probe over official letter pressuring newspaper
item.description: On her official social media page, Vance accused the Homer News of bias and "partisan spin." State law bars legislators from using public resources for "nonlegislative" or partisan political purposes.

item.title: Raising oil, corporate taxes is least-painful option for reducing Alaska deficits, ISER concludes
item.description: The Institute of Social and Economic Research at UAA analyzed the side effects of various taxes and cuts being considered for a long-term state budget-balancing plan.

item.title: WorldQuest 2026 trivia event, Dave Wetzel’s ‘Atmostpheric Landscapes’ at the City Museum, and Pete Griffin’s ‘Diary of a Forest Ranger’ Fireside Lecture
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring WorldQuest 2026, Dave Wetzel opens City Museum exhibition, and Pete Griffin reflects on his 37-year career with U.S. Forest Service at the next Fireside Lecture.

item.title: Under Dunleavy proposal, Juneau residents might pay sales tax on food and utilities again
item.description: Gov. Mike Dunleavy recently proposed a statewide sales tax in his fiscal plan meant to stabilize the state’s finances this legislative session, which would override Juneau’s local exemptions.

item.title: Alaska population rises slightly, but more people continue to move out than move in
item.description: In 2025, the state extended its streak of negative net migration to a post-WWII record of 13 years.

item.title: Live music with Fortenbery, Vidic, The Heists, JGLT On-The-Air presents new Seau N. Sew mystery “The Case of the Aspiring Actress” and Juneau Public Libraries offers new Juneau Reads
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring live music with The Heists and Taylor Dallas Vidic, Juneau Ghost Light Theatre's new live radio play, "The Case of the Aspiring Actress," and upcoming events with Juneau Public Libraries.

item.title: Some small businesses in Juneau speak out against ICE amid nationwide strike
item.description: Several downtown storefronts closed for the day while others took a stance in other ways.

item.title: Juneau School Board seeks feedback for superintendent search
item.description: The Juneau School District Board of Education is working with a search firm to collect feedback from the community before it makes a hiring decision.
